### Verify PayPal Webhook Rejects Invalid Signature

UR-4555: the PayPal webhook endpoint must reject any request that

Tags: paypal_sync, security, negative, webhook, vulnerability_UR4555

Source: `UR_tests/09_ur_membership/06_paypal_payment_sync.robot`

Steps as written:

```
Create Session    paypal_wh_sig_test    ${url}    verify=False    disable_warnings=True
&{headers}=    Create Dictionary Content-Type=application/json PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID=fake-id-security-001 PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z PAYPAL-CERT-URL=https://api.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/notifications/certs/CERT-360caa42 PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG=INVALID_SIGNATURE_MUST_BE_REJECTED_BY_UR4555_FIX
${payload}=    Create Dictionary event_type=BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.ACTIVATED id=WH-SECURITY-TEST-SIG-001 resource={"id":"fake-sub-sig-001","status":"ACTIVE"}
${response}=    POST On Session    paypal_wh_sig_test url=/wp-json/user-registration/paypal-webhook json=${payload} headers=${headers} expected_status=any
Should Not Be Equal As Strings    ${response.status_code}    200 msg=PayPal webhook with invalid signature must not return HTTP 200 — got: ${response.status_code}. UR-4555 fix may not be active.
Log To Console    PayPal webhook invalid signature correctly rejected with HTTP ${response.status_code}
```

Clear PayPal Webhook ID From Settings UI
